Mandatory : No Calculator : None Response Time : N.A Think Time : N.A Minimum Instruction Time : 0 According to the municipalities, in order to get seniors to eat more, the current menu just needed improving, and the municipal leadership wanted your firm to ask elderly clients about their menu preferences. options: This is a great example of how narrow a definition of the problem is.
The opportunity turned out to be exactly what you had in mind.
Why did the municipality kitchen itself not produce a new menu?
Design Thinking cannot be applied here.
questions.correct_answer: This is a great example of how narrow a definition of the problem is.
questions.comprehension_passage: Case Study: Denmark is a country long recognized for its distinctive attention to design. Like citizens in most developed countries, the Danes recognized that the ageing of their population presents many challenges. One of these is serving more than 125,000 senior citizens who rely on government-sponsored meals. Danish municipalities deliver subsidised meals to people who suffer from a reduced ability to function. Whether that is due to illness, age, or other conditions. Many of these seniors have nutritional challenges and a poor quality of life because they simply do not eat enough. An estimated 60% of elders living in assisted living have poor nutrition. An estimated 20% are actually malnourished. In response to this growing social problem, the municipality of Hustobrow decided to dedicate their efforts to improving meal service for seniors. The municipal leadership saw the project initially as straightforward. Answer the given subquestions:

questions.text: Mandatory : No Calculator : None Response Time : N.A Think Time : N.A Minimum Instruction Time : 0 Upon talking to the client (Sukriti), you realised that she has an in-depth knowledge of her work and has maintained a rapport with her customers. With this insight, what should your approach lean towards? [Check all that apply]
options: Help her build a digital presence so people can follow them on Instagram - keeping the brand alive even when the actual shop is shut.
Talk to more restaurant owners to understand their plight, and work towards a more general solution for the local hospitality industry.
Suggest a business model that classifies her as a ‘Frontline worker’ so that she can continue working.
Find the root cause of the problem by examining a general scenario rather than the restricted pandemic-related scenario
correct_answer: Talk to more restaurant owners to understand their plight, and work towards a more general solution for the local hospitality industry.

questions.comprehension_passage: Sukriti started her restaurant in Jalandhar in 2018. When the Pandemic struck in 2020, her work got affected as the streets were under lockdown and no one could access the restaurant physically. Raju, a loyal customer understood the problem and stepped up to help Sukriti. With your learnings of Design Thinking, place yourself in Raju’s shoes and answer the given questions:

questions.text: Mandatory : No Calculator : None Response Time : N.A Think Time : N.A Minimum Instruction Time : 0 While conducting interviews with other restaurant owners, you notice that they seem to be complaining about the delivery charges and expenses of the labour involved in delivering, and transporting the packed food, something Sukriti barely mentioned but also faces trouble with. What would you do? [Check all that apply]
options: Just concentrate your focus on getting her back her lost revenue through better marketing techniques getting her a heavier influx of orders.
Oftentimes, by addressing the needs of an extreme user, the design can translate to solving the needs of the mass, so you give a general physical prototype more priority.
Construct and suggest a standardized structure of delivery rates applicable for all food establishments and make it a general trend so all customers abide by it.
Ask them to become an organized union of restaurant owners and revolt against the attitude of customers
correct_answer: Oftentimes, by addressing the needs of an extreme user, the design can translate to solving the needs of the mass, so you give a general physical prototype more priority.
Construct and suggest a standardized structure of delivery rates applicable for all food establishments and make it a general trend so all customers abide by it.
